description: Transcribe audio. Fetches the URL server-side and forwards as multipart/form-data file upload. Upstream transcription JSON larger than 1 MiB is rejected so word/character timestamps cannot exhaust memory. Timestamp arrays and transcripts longer than 8000 characters are paged in the MCP result: such a transcription returns result_handle alongside the first page, and every later page must be requested with that handle so the clip is transcribed — and charged — exactly once. Handles are held in memory, per MCP session, for 10 minutes and only the 16 most recent survive, after which paging fails and a fresh transcription is needed. Supports x402 wallet auth (no Venice account needed) and API key.

audio_url.description: Audio to transcribe, as an http(s) URL or an inline base64 data URL. Include a concrete media type in data URLs, e.g. audio/mpeg for MP3 or audio/mp4 for M4A. Required unless result_handle is supplied.

result_handle.description: Handle returned by an earlier paged transcription. Pages that retained result without submitting another transcription, so audio_url is ignored when this is set. Expires after 10 minutes or once 16 newer results are retained; an expired handle is an error rather than a silent re-transcription.

text_offset.description: Start character of the transcript page (8000 characters each). Defaults to 0. Use result_handle with next_text_offset to read past the first page.

timestamp_limit.description: Max entries returned per timestamp array. Defaults to 200. Follow next_timestamp_offset; it is null on the last page.

timestamp_offset.description: Start index into each timestamp array (word/segment/char). Defaults to 0. Use result_handle to move past the first page.

timestamps.description: Include word and character timestamps in JSON responses. Defaults to false.
